subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool, switch to a `mode` field, or use a separate append tool before this data-loss fix lands?
rationale: The need for a safe append primitive is well supported, but the permanent model-facing write contract and backend operation shape are maintainer-owned API/product choices.

options.title: Accept append boolean
options.body: Approve `append?: boolean` as the smallest default-preserving contract extension and land after exact-head checks are current.

options.title: Switch to mode
options.body: Ask the branch to use an explicit mode field if maintainers want a more extensible write contract now.

options.title: Use a separate append tool
options.body: Keep `write` overwrite-only and require a distinct append tool if maintainers want stronger operation separation.

recommendation.title: Accept append boolean
recommendation.body: Approve `append?: boolean` as the smallest default-preserving contract extension and land after exact-head checks are current.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current history signal for agent runtime/tool API boundary decisions.
